first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark-colored handgun continuously visible in the lower-right portion of the first-person view, with a long, squared slide; part of the grip is within the frame.

entities.name: riveted metal wall panel
entities.identification: The large light-gray to bluish-gray metal wall panels around the ladder opening, with dark rivet points arranged near the seams.

entities.name: metal floor
entities.identification: The grayish-brown floor partially exposed at the left edge of the image in frame 0, behind the foreground ladder rail.

entities.name: dark-colored metal ceiling
entities.identification: The top panel surface located between the wall panels on both sides in the upward-looking view in the latter portion, appearing dark grayish-brown to olive green.

entities.name: metal ladder
entities.identification: The metal ladder composed of dark-colored long side rails and parallel rungs, which shifts from the left side of the image to the front as the camera turns.

entities.name: hatch guardrail
entities.identification: The thick gray angled bar beside the hatch, which forms an angled arch-shaped outline with an open center on the left side of the image in the latter portion.

entities.name: indoor light fixture
entities.identification: The bluish-white rectangular luminous surface partially exposed in the upper ceiling area in the latter portion, with a gray border around its outside.

entities.name: hatch flange
entities.identification: The thick gray metal edge around the hatch opening, with a layered, stepped structure and bluish-green illuminated surfaces.
